methods.label: Equal contributions among positive results
methods.explanation:
Positive results split into two disjoint cases: having \(D\) and testing positive has probability \((1/5)(4/5)=4/25\), while not having \(D\) and testing positive has probability \((4/5)(1/5)=4/25\). Together they have probability \(8/25>0\). Since the contributions are equal, the conditional probability of having \(D\) given a positive result is
\[
\frac{4/25}{8/25}=\frac12.
\]
